item.title: Building urban resilience against climate-induced extreme floods
item.content:encoded:
This call invites research on strategies and approaches for enhancing urban resilience in the face of climate-related extreme flood events. The focus is on understanding how cities can better prepare for, respond to, and recover from flooding intensified by climate change.

Appel publié par Cities. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Urban resilience
  • Climate-induced extreme floods
  • Cities

Timeline

  • June 11, 2027: Submission deadline
